name: ipmg-referral-hub-static-webapp
description: IPMG Referral Hub static web app for Azure Static Web Apps.

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('staticwebapp.config.json','utf8')); if(!fs.existsSync('index.html')) throw new Error('index.html missing'); console.log('Static app files OK');"
